purpose: Canonical lifecycle and deployment registry for recurring agentic ecosystem roles in MCP Factory.

default_specialist_output_contract.summary: Every specialist role response starts with a compact GM-consumable YAML block before any role-specific detail.

audit_suites.name: dynamic_campaign_default
applies_when: the work is a governed dynamic campaign
acceptable_non_dispatch_reasons: delegation authorization absent
role not decision-bearing this tranche
triggering event did not happen
tranche too small
critical path better kept local
known role failure mode matched current task
required role missing or too degraded for current risk
required_writeback_surfaces: dispatch accountability block in the live tranche artifact
closeout or architect brief when the audit changed blocker ranking or workflow meaning

audit_suites.name: migration_transition_default
applies_when: the work is migration-shaped, cutover-shaped, or compatibility-shaped
required_roles: use-case-specific migration planner when one exists
acceptable_non_dispatch_reasons: delegation authorization absent
work is too small to justify the suite
migration planner does not exist for this slice
root-integrity risk is not part of the proof surface
slice is planning-only and no code-bearing review is needed yet
required role missing or too degraded for current risk
required_writeback_surfaces: dispatch accountability block in the migration artifact
architect brief or closeout if the audit changed legality or rollback meaning

audit_suites.name: proving_default
applies_when: a rerun, proving command, or regression-gate run can affect branch choice, blocker ranking, or next-prompt legality
acceptable_non_dispatch_reasons: delegation authorization absent
no rerun or proving command occurred
result cannot affect branch choice or blocker ranking
required role missing or too degraded for current risk
required_writeback_surfaces: dispatch accountability block in the live tranche artifact
closeout or review summary if the proving audit changed next-branch legality

audit_suites.name: regression_governance_default
applies_when: the work changes runtime, runners, pipeline behavior, stage behavior, compare logic, or regression-gate policy
acceptable_non_dispatch_reasons: delegation authorization absent
change is too small and Tier 0 already covers the claim
required role missing or too degraded for current risk
critical path better kept local for this bounded slice
required_writeback_surfaces: regression posture in the owning artifact
regression result in the owning artifact when a gate or rerun completed
closeout or architect brief when the regression audit changed claim legality

audit_suites.name: system_contract_refactor_default
applies_when: the work is system-contract-shaped or high hidden-consumer-risk
acceptable_non_dispatch_reasons: delegation authorization absent
owned seam already proven local
work is too small to justify dispatch
required role missing or too degraded for current risk
required_writeback_surfaces: dispatch accountability block in the live artifact
system review or blocker writeback when the trace changes system ownership

roles.name: gm_orchestrator
degradation_triggers: stops at prompt-completion boundaries instead of program stop gates
continues while workflow-quality writeback is stale
lets context pressure hide branch-shaping facts in chat memory
fails to update current-truth contracts after current operating truth changes
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Never merge into a specialist role.
roles.notes: Acts as general manager of active truth. Remains parent-thread-only, but now requires authoritative per-tranche workflow scoring and current-truth contract upkeep. Default campaign posture is: Act as GM for this campaign. Delegation authorized for bounded reviewers only. Commit and push validated tranches. No merge. This authorizes bounded reviewers/auditors only; branch choice and product intent remain parent-thread/operator owned.
mandatory_event_triggers: operator says Act as GM for this campaign
a governed dynamic campaign, bounded architecture tranche, or specialist-evaluated workflow is live
skip_conditions: ordinary trivial fix with no campaign, proof, role, or current-truth impact

roles.name: code_review_bot
roles.promotion_gate: One more high-signal real diff review on a runtime-bearing or cross-system change without major overclaim before stable use.
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Split only if correctness and boundary review diverge materially.
roles.notes: Wave 1 custom agent implemented. Two real evaluations completed; supervised use is justified, but the role still needs one more diverse diff review before stable use. Should validate commit handoff structure when commit metadata is available.

roles.name: verification_gate_bot
roles.promotion_gate: One more real checkpoint evaluation with durable verification evidence attachment before stable use.
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Retire only if absorbed by a stronger generic gate with equal specificity.
mandatory_event_triggers: after harness, contract, readiness, or lane-trust work that precedes reopening a more expensive proving band
skip_conditions: tranche too small to justify dispatch
no more expensive proving band is being reopened yet
roles.notes: Wave 1 custom agent implemented. Two real evaluations completed; this role is ready for supervised recurring use but still needs stronger evidence attachment before stable use.

roles.name: handoff_formatter_bot
roles.promotion_gate: 2 clean handoff evaluations with evidence-confidence and test fields behaving well.
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: May merge into external PR tooling later if its structure becomes generic enough.
roles.notes: Keep prompt-only until one more live cycle proves it.

roles.name: run_auditor
roles.promotion_gate: One more real run audit on a different cohort or claim surface before stable use.
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Do not merge with compare-run auditor unless their boundaries become provably fake.
roles.notes: Wave 1 custom agent implemented. Two real evaluations completed; this role is now suitable for supervised recurring run-trust gating.

roles.name: proving-authority-reviewer
roles.promotion_gate: One more live proving-authority gate on a separate rerun or regression-gate family before provisional recurring use.
degradation_triggers: lets stale-lane or stale-code packets steer branch choice
drifts into broader campaign workflow review
duplicates run_auditor or ledger-auditor without a clearer authority verdict
re_evaluation_triggers: new capture integrity requirements are added
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Do not merge with run_auditor unless the narrower authority-versus-claim-ceiling distinction becomes provably fake.
mandatory_event_triggers: after any rerun, proving command, or regression-gate run whose result could affect branch choice
skip_conditions: no rerun or proving command occurred
result cannot affect blocker ranking or next-prompt legality
roles.notes: Default gate-bearing reviewer after reruns, proving commands, and regression-gate runs. The GM still owns blocker ranking and next-prompt choice.

roles.name: ledger_compare_run_auditor
roles.promotion_gate: One more compare-backed claim audit on a separate cohort before stable use.
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: May split later if campaign attribution becomes its own strong recurring role.
roles.notes: Wave 1 custom agent implemented. Two real evaluations completed; this role is now suitable for supervised recurring comparison-truth gating.

roles.name: roadblock_classifier
roles.promotion_gate: One more roadblock revalidation or fresh blocker record with correct anchor and staleness discipline before stable use.
degradation_triggers: multiple blocker classes in one record
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Do not merge with run verification roles.
mandatory_event_triggers: after two bounded cycles fail to narrow the blocker
skip_conditions: blocker already narrowed inside the owning seam
a stronger human-required gate fired first
roles.notes: Wave 1 custom agent implemented. Two real evaluations completed; this role is now suitable for supervised recurring blocker classification.

roles.name: ui_truth_auditor
roles.promotion_gate: Refine current ui-sync-auditor skill and pass 2 more UI truth audits.
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Merge into ui-sync-auditor rather than creating a duplicate long-term skill.
roles.notes: Implement by refining existing ui-sync-auditor skill.

roles.name: coverage_summarizer
roles.promotion_gate: 2 more coverage-framing evals after UI surfaces mature further.
degradation_triggers: pretending future UI framing is already visible
re_evaluation_triggers: new coverage surfaces added to dashboard
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: May promote to skill later if coverage framing becomes a routine closeout task.
roles.notes: Keep prompt-only until UI visibility catches up.

roles.name: dashboard_contract_checker
roles.promotion_gate: Add dedicated skill and pass 2 more contract-integrity audits.
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: May merge with ui_truth_auditor only if README-to-implementation integrity and operator truth drift prove inseparable in practice.
roles.notes: Best implemented as a repo-local skill.

roles.name: regression-governor
roles.promotion_gate: First real evaluation showing that the role chooses the correct tier and claim ceiling on a live runtime- or pipeline-bearing change without drifting into implementation review.
degradation_triggers: requires heavier tiers than policy justifies
re_evaluation_triggers: new heavier suite families are added
CI policy begins consuming regression doctrine
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Retire or merge only if regression posture becomes a built-in default branch-law and no longer needs a distinct governance role.
mandatory_event_triggers: before strong claims on runtime- or pipeline-bearing changes when regression posture is not already explicit
skip_conditions: Tier 0 clearly covers the change with no proving impact
roles.notes: Candidate governance role for making regression posture explicit before claims, pushes, or next-prompt steering.

roles.name: system-contract-tracer
roles.promotion_gate: One more real system trace on a separate proving, operator-truth, or regression-system surface with a clean non-blocking sidecar outcome before provisional recurring use.
degradation_triggers: overclassification of local defects as missing systems
blocking the parent thread without a gating reason
re_evaluation_triggers: major route or artifact schema changes
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: May merge later with stronger mapping or architecture-review systems only if end-to-end traceability remains equally explicit and reusable.
mandatory_event_triggers: after any material code / artifact / status / operator-truth divergence when the blocker is system-shaped
roles.notes: High-priority sidecar reviewer for system-shaped work. The GM owns the queue and should not wait on this role reflexively.

roles.name: campaign-output-ledger
roles.promotion_gate: One live dynamic campaign using the role end to end with clear continuation and operator-readability gains before provisional recurring use.
degradation_triggers: generic narration instead of structured deltas
blocking the parent thread without output-coherence necessity
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: May merge later with stronger campaign automation only if incremental campaign memory remains equally explicit, reviewable, and GM-supervised.
mandatory_event_triggers: for every governed dynamic-campaign tranche from prompt start through prompt close when delegation is authorized
skip_conditions: work is not a governed dynamic campaign
campaign output coherence is already the active gate and the GM is intentionally keeping the tranche local
roles.notes: High-priority non-blocking sidecar for dynamic campaigns. The GM remains the authoritative writer of repo-tracked campaign artifacts, the authoritative workflow scorer, and the authoritative dispatch-accountability recorder.

roles.name: campaign-reviewer
roles.promotion_gate: One more live overnight or multi-prompt campaign showing useful prompt-close and morning review output without ceremony before provisional recurring use.
degradation_triggers: tries to choose the next branch
turns prompt-close review into generic narration
blocks ordinary prompt closes without a pause or handoff reason
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: May split later only if prompt-close review and morning-principles review prove to have different triggers or outputs.
roles.notes: Default parallel reviewer for dynamic campaigns. Owns reviewer artifacts only and stays distinct from proving-authority-reviewer.

roles.name: stage-split-migration-planner
roles.promotion_gate: One real stage-split cutover planning task with a useful compatibility matrix, staged rollout order, and rollback boundary before promotion to calibrating.
degradation_triggers: generic architecture commentary instead of cutover planning
migration plans that do not change the next branch decision
re_evaluation_triggers: new artifact consumers or checkpoint owners appear
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Retire or merge only if stage migration planning proves inseparable from a stronger contract-migration role in practice.
roles.notes: New transition-owned role candidate. Needed because current roles do not cleanly own old-to-new stage mapping, temporary compatibility, and cutover sequencing.

roles.name: artifact-root-integrity-auditor
owner_surfaces: packet claim ceiling from root integrity
roles.promotion_gate: One real proving-packet integrity audit that correctly separates clean-root, mixed-root, stale-root, and inherited-artifact cases before promotion to calibrating.
degradation_triggers: packet trust claims without root-evidence citation
collapsing inherited-artifact ambiguity into generic failure language
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Retire or merge only if run_auditor or proving-authority-reviewer can prove equal specificity on artifact-root integrity without losing the narrower contamination question.
roles.notes: New evidence-integrity role candidate. Needed because stale root reuse has already poisoned proving trust and is not fully owned by lane-trust or run-authority roles.

roles.name: baseline-breakage-map-auditor
roles.promotion_gate: One real migration tranche where the role improves BASELINE-BREAKAGE-MAP.md accuracy without choosing the next branch before promotion to calibrating.
degradation_triggers: claim-ceiling decisions that duplicate regression-governor without added breakage-map value
owner attribution without stage TRACE or FAMILY-BLOCKERS evidence
treating expected drift as durable-contract regression without evidence
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Merge into regression-governor or campaign-reviewer if repeated use proves the breakage-map audit is not distinct from claim-ceiling or closeout review.
roles.notes: First breakage-map-specific candidate role. Keep prompt-only until live migration evidence proves it improves owner attribution and next bounded fix selection.

roles.name: campaign-workflow-auditor
owner_surfaces: historical dynamic campaign workflow pressure tests
roles.promotion_gate: Merged into campaign-reviewer; no further promotion path while the merge stands.
re_evaluation_triggers: only if future evidence justifies splitting workflow review away from campaign-reviewer again
roles.merge_or_retirement_condition: Already merged into campaign-reviewer; retain only as historical governance memory.
roles.notes: Historical role retained so older campaign artifacts and evals remain interpretable. Do not dispatch for new work.
